# RevoTask: Requirements

Project brief, user roles, core features, tech stack, non-functional requirements, and every requirement with its acceptance criteria. Slice 00 holds the brief and cross-cutting requirements.

## 00 Foundation

### Project brief

**Overview.** RevoTask is a Trello-like task management application built through a disciplined AI-driven workflow (Kiro and Kiro CLI). Users create boards, organize work into columns, move cards between stages by drag-and-drop, collaborate through comments, and track the tasks assigned to them. A Flask API and a Next.js frontend are deployed separately.

**User roles.**

| Role                | Can do                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Board member        | Create boards, add columns and cards, move cards, comment, edit their own comments, track assigned tasks, receive notifications.                                                          |
| Board administrator | Everything a member can do, plus rename or delete the board, manage member access and roles, delete columns, and view board analytics. The creator of a board is its first administrator. |

**Core features.** JWT authentication with protected routes; boards, columns and cards; FLOAT-ordered drag-and-drop; comments (owner-only edit and delete); notifications with a polled unread badge; card search with a 300 ms debounce; My Tasks; profile management; board analytics.

**Tech stack.** Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, react-hot-toast, Playwright, Vitest and React Testing Library. Flask, SQLAlchemy, Flask-Migrate, Flask-JWT-Extended, Marshmallow, PostgreSQL, python-dotenv, Gunicorn, pytest. Vercel (API), Vercel (web). Kiro and Kiro CLI as the AI tools.

**Non-functional requirements.** Security, reliability, responsiveness and accessibility, performance, and maintainability. They are specified as REQ-NFR-1 to REQ-NFR-5 below.

### Scope of this slice

Health endpoint, shared API envelope, environment configuration, shared UI components and API client, quality gates, and the cross-cutting E2E journey.

### Requirements

#### REQ-FND-1 · Health check

**Story:** As an operator, I want a health endpoint so that deployments and monitors can verify the API and its database.

- **AC-FND-1.1** WHEN `GET /api/health` is called without a token, THEN the API SHALL respond `200` with `{"data": {"status": "ok", "database": "up"}}`.
- **AC-FND-1.2** IF the database cannot be reached, THEN the API SHALL respond `503` with the error envelope instead of a false `200`.

#### REQ-FND-2 · Response envelope and error handling

**Story:** As a frontend developer, I want one response shape so that every call is handled the same way.

- **AC-FND-2.1** WHEN a request succeeds, THEN the response body SHALL contain exactly one top-level key, `data`.
- **AC-FND-2.2** WHEN a request fails, THEN the body SHALL be `{"error": "<message>", "code": "<CODE>"}` with an optional `details` object, and `error` SHALL be a string.
- **AC-FND-2.3** WHEN a route does not exist, the method is wrong, or the JSON is malformed, THEN the API SHALL return the error envelope with `404`, `405` or `400`, not an HTML page.
- **AC-FND-2.4** WHEN an unexpected exception occurs, THEN the API SHALL respond `500` with the generic message `Internal server error` and SHALL NOT include the exception text, SQL or a stack trace.
- **AC-FND-2.5** WHEN a JWT is missing, malformed or expired, THEN the API SHALL respond `401` in the envelope (never `422`).

#### REQ-FND-3 · Configuration from the environment

**Story:** As a deployer, I want all configuration in environment variables so that no secret is committed.

- **AC-FND-3.1** WHEN the app starts, THEN `config.py` SHALL be the only module that reads `os.environ`, and no secret or database URL SHALL have a literal default in code.
- **AC-FND-3.2** IF `APP_ENV=production` and `SECRET_KEY` or `JWT_SECRET_KEY` is missing or shorter than 32 characters, THEN startup SHALL fail with a clear error.
- **AC-FND-3.3** IF `DATABASE_URL` is missing, THEN startup SHALL fail; a `postgres://` or `postgresql://` URL SHALL be rewritten to `postgresql+psycopg://`.
- **AC-FND-3.4** WHEN `CORS_ORIGINS` lists origins, THEN preflight requests from those origins SHALL succeed and others SHALL receive no CORS headers.
- **AC-FND-3.5** WHEN the repository is inspected, THEN `.env.example` SHALL exist for both projects with placeholder values and no real `.env*` file SHALL be tracked.
- **AC-FND-3.6** WHEN the app runs on Vercel (`VERCEL=1`), THEN the database engine SHALL open connections per request without a pool and SHALL disable psycopg server-side prepared statements; WHEN it runs elsewhere, THEN it SHALL keep a pre-pinged pool.

#### REQ-FND-4 · Typed API client

**Story:** As a frontend developer, I want one typed fetch wrapper so that token handling and errors are consistent.

- **AC-FND-4.1** WHEN code runs in the browser, THEN `lib/apiClient.ts` SHALL use `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`; WHEN it runs on the server, THEN it SHALL use `API_BASE_URL`.
- **AC-FND-4.2** WHEN a token is supplied, THEN the request SHALL carry `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- **AC-FND-4.3** WHEN the response is not 2xx or the network fails, THEN the client SHALL throw `ApiError` with `statusCode` and `message` (status `0` for network failure).
- **AC-FND-4.4** WHEN a response succeeds, THEN the client SHALL return the unwrapped `data` typed by the caller.

#### REQ-FND-5 · Error toasts

**Story:** As a user, I want clear messages when something fails so that I know what to do next.

- **AC-FND-5.1** WHEN `useErrorHandler` receives an `ApiError`, THEN it SHALL show a toast chosen by `statusCode` (network, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429, 5xx).
- **AC-FND-5.2** WHEN the error is not an `ApiError`, THEN the toast SHALL be generic and SHALL NOT show the error's own message.
- **AC-FND-5.3** WHEN the status is 401, THEN the handler SHALL also sign the user out.
- **AC-FND-5.4** `lib/toast.ts` SHALL wrap `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` and `toast.loading()`.

#### REQ-FND-6 · Shared UI components

**Story:** As a user, I want consistent buttons, badges and dialogs so that the product feels coherent and accessible.

- **AC-FND-6.1** `BaseButton` SHALL offer primary, secondary and destructive variants, default to `type="button"`, and keep a 44 px minimum hit target.
- **AC-FND-6.2** `BaseBadge` SHALL offer color variants.
- **AC-FND-6.3** `BaseModal` SHALL expose `role="dialog"` with a unique `aria-labelledby`, close on Escape, lock page scroll, and return focus to the opener.
- **AC-FND-6.4** Pages and feature components SHALL use `BaseButton` and SHALL contain no raw `<button>` elements; every in-app form SHALL be wrapped in `BaseModal`.

#### REQ-FND-7 · Schema migrations

**Story:** As a deployer, I want reproducible schema changes so that production matches the models.

- **AC-FND-7.1** WHEN `flask db upgrade` runs on an empty PostgreSQL database, THEN it SHALL create all tables and `flask db downgrade base` SHALL remove them.
- **AC-FND-7.2** WHEN `flask db check` runs after upgrade, THEN it SHALL report no model drift.

#### REQ-FND-8 · Quality gates and delivery

**Story:** As a maintainer, I want automated checks so that regressions and guideline violations are caught before merge.

- **AC-FND-8.1** CI SHALL run ruff, pytest (on PostgreSQL), `flask db upgrade`, ESLint, `tsc`, Vitest, `next build`, `scripts/check_guidelines.py` and `scripts/check_traceability.py`.
- **AC-FND-8.2** The API SHALL be deployed on a public Vercel URL where `GET /api/health`, register and login succeed. _(verified manually after deploy)_
- **AC-FND-8.3** The web app SHALL be deployed on a public Vercel URL connected to that API. _(verified manually after deploy)_

#### REQ-E2E-1 · Kanban journey

**Story:** As a product owner, I want the complete journey automated so that deployment regressions are caught.

- **AC-E2E-1.1** WHEN the Playwright suite runs against `PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL`, THEN one journey SHALL cover, in order: register, login, create a board, add columns, create and drag cards, add and edit a comment, search for a card, and view the notification bell.
- **AC-E2E-1.2** WHEN a card is dragged to another column and the page is reloaded, THEN it SHALL still be in the new column.
- **AC-E2E-1.3** The suite SHALL contain no `waitForTimeout` and SHALL create uniquely named data per run.

#### REQ-NFR-1 · Security

- **AC-NFR-1.1** Passwords SHALL be stored only as scrypt hashes and SHALL never appear in a response or log.
- **AC-NFR-1.2** Every board, column, card and comment operation SHALL be authorized in the service layer against board membership and role.
- **AC-NFR-1.3** JWTs SHALL expire (default 60 minutes) and every protected route SHALL require a valid token.

#### REQ-NFR-2 · Reliability

- **AC-NFR-2.1** Card and column positions SHALL persist and survive a page reload.
- **AC-NFR-2.2** WHEN an optimistic move fails, THEN the UI SHALL restore the original position.
- **AC-NFR-2.3** Deleted content SHALL be recoverable (soft delete) and never silently cascade-destroyed.

#### REQ-NFR-3 · Responsive and accessible UI

- **AC-NFR-3.1** At a 375 px viewport no page SHALL scroll horizontally, and the Kanban board SHALL scroll inside its own container.
- **AC-NFR-3.2** Every input SHALL have a visible label, and every drag action SHALL have a keyboard or touch alternative.

#### REQ-NFR-4 · Performance

- **AC-NFR-4.1** `GET /api/boards/<id>` SHALL use a fixed number of queries regardless of the number of cards.
- **AC-NFR-4.2** Every list endpoint SHALL be bounded (pagination or a maximum limit).

#### REQ-NFR-5 · Maintainability and traceability

- **AC-NFR-5.1** Every requirement SHALL have an acceptance criterion, a design mapping, a task, and a test or code reference, enforced by `scripts/check_traceability.py`.
- **AC-NFR-5.2** Code SHALL follow `guidelines/`, enforced where possible by `scripts/check_guidelines.py`.

## 01 Auth Users

### Scope

Registration, login, JWT lifecycle, route protection, the current user's profile, and profile updates.

### Requirements

#### REQ-AUTH-1 · Register

**Story:** As a visitor, I want to create an account so that I can use RevoTask.

- **AC-AUTH-1.1** WHEN `POST /api/auth/register` receives a valid `name`, `email` and `password`, THEN the API SHALL create the user, respond `201` with `{"data": {"user": {...}}}`, and the user object SHALL NOT contain the password or its hash.
- **AC-AUTH-1.2** The password SHALL be stored only as a scrypt hash.
- **AC-AUTH-1.3** The email SHALL be stored lower-case.

#### REQ-AUTH-2 · Registration validation

**Story:** As a visitor, I want clear errors when my input is wrong.

- **AC-AUTH-2.1** WHEN the email already exists (any letter case), THEN the API SHALL respond `409` with code `CONFLICT`.
- **AC-AUTH-2.2** WHEN `name` is blank, `email` is invalid, the password is shorter than 8 characters or lacks a letter and a number, or an unknown field is sent, THEN the API SHALL respond `400` with field-level `details`.
- **AC-AUTH-2.3** WHEN the body is not a JSON object, THEN the API SHALL respond `400`.

#### REQ-AUTH-3 · Login

**Story:** As a user, I want to sign in and receive a token so that I can call protected endpoints.

- **AC-AUTH-3.1** WHEN `POST /api/auth/login` receives valid credentials, THEN the API SHALL respond `200` with `access_token`, `token_type: "Bearer"`, `expires_in` and the user.
- **AC-AUTH-3.2** The token SHALL carry `sub` (the user id), `iat` and an `exp` equal to `iat + expires_in`; the lifetime SHALL come from `JWT_ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES` (default 60).

#### REQ-AUTH-4 · Safe login failures

**Story:** As an account owner, I do not want attackers to learn which emails are registered.

- **AC-AUTH-4.1** WHEN the email is unknown or the password is wrong, THEN the API SHALL respond `401` with the identical message `Invalid email or password`.
- **AC-AUTH-4.2** WHEN the email is unknown, THEN the API SHALL still perform a password-hash verification so response time does not reveal the account.
- **AC-AUTH-4.3** WHEN `email` or `password` is missing, THEN the API SHALL respond `400`.

#### REQ-AUTH-5 · Register page

**Story:** As a visitor, I want a register form that checks my input before I submit.

- **AC-AUTH-5.1** `/register` SHALL show controlled inputs for name, email, password and confirmation.
- **AC-AUTH-5.2** WHEN a field loses focus or the form is submitted, THEN client validation SHALL show an error beside the field, and invalid input SHALL NOT call the API.
- **AC-AUTH-5.3** WHEN input is valid, THEN the page SHALL `POST /api/auth/register` and redirect to `/login?registered=1`.
- **AC-AUTH-5.4** WHEN the API returns `409`, THEN the page SHALL show the message under the email field.

#### REQ-AUTH-6 · Login page and session

**Story:** As a user, I want to sign in and stay signed in across reloads.

- **AC-AUTH-6.1** WHEN valid credentials are submitted at `/login`, THEN the token SHALL be stored in `AuthContext` (mirrored in a `SameSite=Lax` cookie) and the user SHALL be redirected to the dashboard, or to a same-site `next` path.
- **AC-AUTH-6.2** WHEN the API returns `401`, THEN the page SHALL show "Invalid email or password." and stay on `/login`.
- **AC-AUTH-6.3** The `next` parameter SHALL be accepted only when it is a same-site path (no open redirect).
- **AC-AUTH-6.4** WHEN the token expires, THEN the app SHALL clear the session and send the user to `/login`.

#### REQ-AUTH-7 · Route protection

**Story:** As an owner of private data, I want protected pages to require sign-in.

- **AC-AUTH-7.1** WHEN a visitor without a valid token opens `/`, `/boards/*`, `/my-tasks` or `/profile`, THEN `middleware.ts` SHALL redirect to `/login` (with `next` set for non-root paths).
- **AC-AUTH-7.2** WHEN a Server Component receives `401` from the API, THEN it SHALL redirect to `/login?expired=1`.
- **AC-AUTH-7.3** Every protected API route SHALL independently require a valid JWT.

#### REQ-AUTH-8 · Logout

**Story:** As a user on a shared computer, I want to sign out completely.

- **AC-AUTH-8.1** WHEN the user clicks "Log out", THEN `AuthContext` and the session cookie SHALL be cleared and the user SHALL land on `/login`.
- **AC-AUTH-8.2** WHEN a signed-out user opens a protected page, THEN they SHALL be redirected to `/login`.

#### REQ-USER-1 · Read my profile

- **AC-USER-1.1** WHEN `GET /api/users/me` is called with a valid token, THEN the API SHALL respond `200` with `id`, `name`, `email`, `created_at` and no password data.
- **AC-USER-1.2** WHEN the token is missing, malformed or expired, THEN the API SHALL respond `401`.

#### REQ-USER-2 · Update my profile

- **AC-USER-2.1** WHEN `PATCH /api/users/me` receives `name` and/or `email`, THEN the API SHALL update them (email lower-cased) and respond `200` with the profile.
- **AC-USER-2.2** WHEN the new email belongs to another user, THEN the API SHALL respond `409`; WHEN it is the user's own email, THEN it SHALL succeed.
- **AC-USER-2.3** WHEN the body is empty or the email is invalid, THEN the API SHALL respond `400`.

#### REQ-USER-3 · Password changes are not allowed here

- **AC-USER-3.1** WHEN `PATCH /api/users/me` includes `password` (or any unknown field), THEN the API SHALL respond `400` and change nothing.

#### REQ-USER-4 · Profile page

**Story:** As a user, I want to update my name and email.

- **AC-USER-4.1** `/profile` SHALL show a controlled form pre-populated from `AuthContext`.
- **AC-USER-4.2** WHEN the form is valid and submitted, THEN the page SHALL `PATCH /api/users/me`, update `AuthContext`, and show a success toast.
- **AC-USER-4.3** WHEN the API returns `409`, THEN the page SHALL show the message under the email field.
- **AC-USER-4.4** The page SHALL use `BaseButton` for its actions, including "Log out".

## 02 Boards Members

### Scope

Creating, listing, reading, renaming and deleting boards; board membership and roles; the Dashboard and Board Detail pages. Permissions follow `docs/contracts/permission-matrix.md`.

### Requirements

#### REQ-BOARD-1 · Create a board

**Story:** As a user, I want to create a board so that I can organize a project.

- **AC-BOARD-1.1** WHEN `POST /api/boards` receives a non-blank `name` (at most 100 characters), THEN the API SHALL create the board, make the caller its `admin`, and respond `201` with the board summary.
- **AC-BOARD-1.2** WHEN `name` is blank, too long, or an unknown field is sent, THEN the API SHALL respond `400`.
- **AC-BOARD-1.3** WHEN the token is missing, THEN the API SHALL respond `401`.

#### REQ-BOARD-2 · List my boards

- **AC-BOARD-2.1** WHEN `GET /api/boards` is called, THEN the API SHALL return only boards the caller belongs to, newest first, each with `role` and `member_count`.
- **AC-BOARD-2.2** Soft-deleted boards SHALL NOT appear.
- **AC-BOARD-2.3** WHEN the token is missing, THEN the API SHALL respond `401`.

#### REQ-BOARD-3 · Read a board with columns and cards

- **AC-BOARD-3.1** WHEN a member calls `GET /api/boards/<id>`, THEN the API SHALL return the board, its members, and its columns ordered by `order`, each with its cards ordered by `order`.
- **AC-BOARD-3.2** WHEN the caller is not a member, THEN the API SHALL respond `403`; WHEN the board does not exist, is soft-deleted, or the id is not a UUID, THEN `404`.
- **AC-BOARD-3.3** The number of SQL queries SHALL NOT depend on the number of cards.

#### REQ-BOARD-4 · Rename a board

- **AC-BOARD-4.1** WHEN an admin calls `PATCH /api/boards/<id>` with a valid `name`, THEN the API SHALL rename it and respond `200`.
- **AC-BOARD-4.2** WHEN the caller is a non-admin member, THEN the API SHALL respond `403`; WHEN `name` is blank, THEN `400`.

#### REQ-BOARD-5 · Delete a board

- **AC-BOARD-5.1** WHEN an admin calls `DELETE /api/boards/<id>`, THEN the API SHALL soft-delete the board, its columns, their cards and those cards' comments in one transaction and respond `200` with the id.
- **AC-BOARD-5.2** WHEN the caller is a non-admin member, THEN the API SHALL respond `403`.
- **AC-BOARD-5.3** After deletion the board SHALL return `404` and its cards SHALL NOT appear in any list.

#### REQ-BOARD-6 · Manage members

**Story:** As a board administrator, I want to control who can access my board.

- **AC-BOARD-6.1** WHEN an admin calls `POST /api/boards/<id>/members` with an existing user's `email` and a `role`, THEN the API SHALL add the member, notify them, and respond `201`.
- **AC-BOARD-6.2** WHEN the email is unknown, THEN the API SHALL respond `404`; WHEN the user is already a member, THEN `409`; WHEN a non-admin calls, THEN `403`.
- **AC-BOARD-6.3** WHEN an admin calls `PATCH /api/boards/<id>/members/<user_id>` with a valid role, THEN the API SHALL change it; an invalid role SHALL be `400`.
- **AC-BOARD-6.4** WHEN an admin calls `DELETE /api/boards/<id>/members/<user_id>`, THEN the member SHALL be removed and that user's cards on the board SHALL become unassigned.
- **AC-BOARD-6.5** WHEN a request would remove or demote the last admin, THEN the API SHALL respond `409`.
- **AC-BOARD-6.6** Any member SHALL be able to list members with `GET /api/boards/<id>/members`.

#### REQ-BOARD-7 · Dashboard page

**Story:** As a user, I want to see my boards when I open the app.

- **AC-BOARD-7.1** `/` SHALL be a Server Component that fetches `GET /api/boards` and lists every board as a link with its name, role badge and member count.
- **AC-BOARD-7.2** WHEN the user has no boards, THEN the page SHALL show an empty state.
- **AC-BOARD-7.3** "New board" SHALL open a `BaseModal` form; on success the user SHALL be taken to the new board.

#### REQ-BOARD-8 · Board detail page

**Story:** As a member, I want to see the board as a Kanban layout.

- **AC-BOARD-8.1** `/boards/[id]` SHALL be a Server Component that fetches the board and renders its columns and cards in a Kanban layout.
- **AC-BOARD-8.2** WHEN the API returns `404`, THEN the page SHALL show the not-found page; WHEN `403`, THEN a "no access" message with a link back.
- **AC-BOARD-8.3** Admins SHALL see Rename, Delete board and Analytics actions; members SHALL NOT.
- **AC-BOARD-8.4** The Members dialog SHALL list members with roles; admins SHALL be able to add, change role and remove.

## 03 Columns Cards

### Scope

Columns, cards, FLOAT ordering, drag-and-drop between columns, My Tasks, and card search. Ordering rules are in `docs/contracts/ordering.md`.

### Requirements

#### REQ-COL-1 · Add a column

- **AC-COL-1.1** WHEN a member calls `POST /api/boards/<id>/columns` with a non-blank `name` (at most 100 characters), THEN the API SHALL create the column at `max(order) + 1024` (or `1024` when empty) and respond `201`.
- **AC-COL-1.2** WHEN `name` is blank or an unknown field is sent, THEN the API SHALL respond `400`; no token → `401`; non-member → `403`; unknown board → `404`.
- **AC-COL-1.3** A column MAY be flagged `is_done` so cards in it count as completed.

#### REQ-COL-2 · Rename a column

- **AC-COL-2.1** WHEN a member calls `PATCH /api/columns/<id>` with `name` and/or `is_done`, THEN the API SHALL update them and respond `200`.
- **AC-COL-2.2** WHEN the body is empty, THEN `400`; WHEN the caller is not a member, THEN `403`.

#### REQ-COL-3 · Delete a column

- **AC-COL-3.1** WHEN an admin calls `DELETE /api/columns/<id>`, THEN the API SHALL soft-delete the column and its cards and respond `200`.
- **AC-COL-3.2** WHEN a non-admin member calls, THEN `403`; WHEN the column is already deleted, THEN `404`.

#### REQ-COL-4 · Reorder columns (FLOAT strategy)

- **AC-COL-4.1** WHEN a member calls `PATCH /api/boards/<id>/columns/reorder` with `items: [{id, order}]`, THEN the API SHALL set each column's `order` and respond `200` with the full ordered list.
- **AC-COL-4.2** WHEN an `order` is not a positive finite float, an `id` repeats, an `id` is not a live column of this board, or `items` is empty, THEN the API SHALL respond `400` and change nothing.
- **AC-COL-4.3** WHEN two columns end up with a gap below `1e-6`, THEN the API SHALL renumber the board's columns to multiples of 1024 in the same transaction.
- **AC-COL-4.4** The Board page SHALL offer move-left and move-right controls that compute the new order locally and roll back on failure.

#### REQ-CARD-1 · Create a card

- **AC-CARD-1.1** WHEN a member calls `POST /api/columns/<id>/cards` with a non-blank `title` (at most 200 characters), THEN the API SHALL create the card at the end of the column, record `created_by`, and respond `201`.
- **AC-CARD-1.2** WHEN `title` is blank, `order` is not positive, or an unknown field is sent, THEN `400`; no token → `401`; non-member → `403`; unknown column → `404`.
- **AC-CARD-1.3** The Board page SHALL create cards through a `BaseModal` form and show them in the column at once.

#### REQ-CARD-2 · Update a card and assign it

- **AC-CARD-2.1** WHEN a member calls `PATCH /api/cards/<id>` with `title`, `description` and/or `assignee_id`, THEN the API SHALL update them; `assignee_id: null` SHALL unassign.
- **AC-CARD-2.2** WHEN `assignee_id` is not a member of the card's board, THEN `400` with code `INVALID_ASSIGNEE`.
- **AC-CARD-2.3** WHEN the body is empty or contains an unknown field (such as `order`), THEN `400`; non-member → `403`; unknown card → `404`.
- **AC-CARD-2.4** WHEN a card is assigned to someone other than the actor, THEN that user SHALL receive a `card_assigned` notification.

#### REQ-CARD-3 · Delete a card

- **AC-CARD-3.1** WHEN the card's creator or a board admin calls `DELETE /api/cards/<id>`, THEN the API SHALL soft-delete the card and its comments and respond `200`.
- **AC-CARD-3.2** WHEN another member calls, THEN `403`; WHEN the card is already deleted, THEN `404`.

#### REQ-CARD-4 · Move a card

- **AC-CARD-4.1** WHEN a member calls `PATCH /api/cards/<id>/position` with a valid `column_id` and `order`, THEN the API SHALL update the card's column and order and respond `200` with `{card, rebalanced}`.
- **AC-CARD-4.2** WHEN the destination column is on a different board, THEN `400` with code `INVALID_MOVE`; unknown column → `404`; non-member → `403`; no token → `401`.
- **AC-CARD-4.3** WHEN the card enters a different column, THEN `column_entered_at` SHALL be set to now.
- **AC-CARD-4.4** After a move, `GET /api/boards/<id>` SHALL return the card in the new column in the new order.

#### REQ-CARD-5 · CardPositionSchema validation

- **AC-CARD-5.1** `CardPositionSchema` SHALL require `column_id` to be a valid UUID and `order` to be a float greater than 0, finite, and at most `1e12`.
- **AC-CARD-5.2** WHEN `column_id` is missing or malformed, or `order` is missing, zero, negative, a string, a boolean, `NaN`, or too large, or an extra key is present, THEN the API SHALL respond `400`.

#### REQ-CARD-6 · Rebalancing

- **AC-CARD-6.1** WHEN a move leaves two cards in the destination column with equal orders or a gap below `1e-6`, THEN the API SHALL renumber that column to `1024, 2048, ...` in the same transaction and return `rebalanced: true`.
- **AC-CARD-6.2** WHEN the response has `rebalanced: true`, THEN the client SHALL refetch the board.

#### REQ-CARD-7 · My Tasks

**Story:** As a user, I want one list of everything assigned to me.

- **AC-CARD-7.1** WHEN `GET /api/cards?assignee=me` is called, THEN the API SHALL return only live cards assigned to the caller on boards where they are a member, each with its `board` and `column` names.
- **AC-CARD-7.2** WHEN `assignee` has any value other than `me`, THEN `400`; no token → `401`.
- **AC-CARD-7.3** `/my-tasks` SHALL be a Server Component that fetches that endpoint and groups the cards by board name, with an empty state and an "Open board" `BaseButton` per group.

#### REQ-CARD-8 · Card search

- **AC-CARD-8.1** WHEN `GET /api/cards?q=<text>&board_id=<id>` is called, THEN the API SHALL return live cards whose title or description contains the text (case-insensitive, `%` and `_` treated literally), at most `limit` (default 50, maximum 100).
- **AC-CARD-8.2** WHEN the caller is not a member of `board_id`, THEN `403`.
- **AC-CARD-8.3** The Board page search box SHALL send a request only after 300 ms without typing and SHALL list matching cards; choosing one SHALL open its details.

#### REQ-CARD-9 · Drag and drop

- **AC-CARD-9.1** `hooks/useDragAndDrop.ts` SHALL use the native HTML5 Drag and Drop API to drag a card between and within columns.
- **AC-CARD-9.2** WHEN a card is dropped, THEN the hook SHALL update local state immediately (optimistic update) and call `PATCH /api/cards/<id>/position` with an order computed from its new neighbours.
- **AC-CARD-9.3** WHEN the API returns an error, THEN the hook SHALL restore the card to its original column and position and report the error.
- **AC-CARD-9.4** WHEN a card is dropped where it already is, THEN no request SHALL be sent.
- **AC-CARD-9.5** The card details dialog SHALL offer "Move to column" as a keyboard and touch alternative using the same optimistic move.

## 04 Comments Activity

### Scope

Commenting on cards, owner-only edit and delete, and the card details dialog that hosts the comment thread.

### Requirements

#### REQ-CMT-1 · Add a comment

**Story:** As a member, I want to comment on a card so that my team sees my update.

- **AC-CMT-1.1** WHEN a board member calls `POST /api/cards/<id>/comments` with non-blank `content` (at most 2000 characters), THEN the API SHALL create the comment with `user_id` taken from the token and respond `201` with the comment and its author.
- **AC-CMT-1.2** WHEN `content` is missing, blank or too long, or the body contains `user_id` or any unknown field, THEN the API SHALL respond `400`.
- **AC-CMT-1.3** WHEN no token is sent, THEN the API SHALL respond `401`.
- **AC-CMT-1.4** WHEN the caller is not a member of the card's board, THEN the API SHALL respond `403`.

#### REQ-CMT-2 · List comments

- **AC-CMT-2.1** WHEN a member calls `GET /api/cards/<id>/comments`, THEN the API SHALL return the card's live comments oldest first.
- **AC-CMT-2.2** WHEN the caller is not a member, THEN `403`; unknown card → `404`; no token → `401`.

#### REQ-CMT-3 · Edit a comment (owner only)

- **AC-CMT-3.1** WHEN the author calls `PATCH /api/comments/<id>` with valid `content`, THEN the API SHALL update it, advance `updated_at`, and respond `200`.
- **AC-CMT-3.2** WHEN any other user, including a board admin, calls, THEN the API SHALL respond `403` and change nothing.
- **AC-CMT-3.3** WHEN `content` is blank, THEN `400`; unknown or deleted comment → `404`; no token → `401`.

#### REQ-CMT-4 · Delete a comment (owner only)

- **AC-CMT-4.1** WHEN the author calls `DELETE /api/comments/<id>`, THEN the API SHALL soft-delete it and respond `200`; it SHALL disappear from the list.
- **AC-CMT-4.2** WHEN any other user, including a board admin, calls, THEN `403`; a second delete → `404`; no token → `401`.

#### REQ-CMT-5 · Card details dialog and comment list

**Story:** As a member, I want to read and write comments without leaving the board.

- **AC-CMT-5.1** `CardDetailModal.tsx` SHALL be a Client Component that composes `CommentList.tsx` inside `BaseModal.tsx`.
- **AC-CMT-5.2** The dialog SHALL contain a comment form that submits to `POST /api/cards/<id>/comments` and appends the new comment without a reload.
- **AC-CMT-5.3** `CommentList` SHALL show loading, error and empty states, and SHALL offer Edit and Delete only on the current user's comments.
- **AC-CMT-5.4** Editing SHALL happen inline, keep the editor open if saving fails, and mark edited comments.
- **AC-CMT-5.5** Comment text SHALL render as plain text; markup SHALL NOT be interpreted.

## 05 Notifications

### Scope

In-app notifications, pagination, mark-as-read, and the header bell that polls for new ones. Notifications are in-app only; no email or push.

### Requirements

#### REQ-NOTIF-1 · List notifications

- **AC-NOTIF-1.1** WHEN `GET /api/notifications` is called, THEN the API SHALL return the caller's notifications newest first as `{items, page, per_page, total, pages, unread_count}`.
- **AC-NOTIF-1.2** WHEN `page` and `per_page` are given, THEN the API SHALL slice accordingly; the defaults SHALL be page 1 and 20 per page.
- **AC-NOTIF-1.3** WHEN `page` is below 1, or `per_page` is below 1, above 100, or not a number, THEN `400`.
- **AC-NOTIF-1.4** A user SHALL only ever see their own notifications; no token → `401`.

#### REQ-NOTIF-2 · Mark a notification as read

- **AC-NOTIF-2.1** WHEN the owner calls `PATCH /api/notifications/<id>/read`, THEN the API SHALL set `read_at` and respond `200` with `read: true`; repeating the call SHALL be harmless.
- **AC-NOTIF-2.2** WHEN the notification belongs to another user or does not exist, THEN `404` (so ids are never confirmed); no token → `401`.

#### REQ-NOTIF-3 · Polling hook and bell

**Story:** As a user, I want to see new activity without reloading.

- **AC-NOTIF-3.1** `hooks/useNotifications.ts` SHALL load notifications on mount and then poll `GET /api/notifications` every 30 seconds while signed in.
- **AC-NOTIF-3.2** The hook SHALL skip a tick while a request is in flight, stop polling on unmount or sign-out, and sign the user out on `401`.
- **AC-NOTIF-3.3** `NotificationBell.tsx` SHALL show the unread count as a badge in the header, with an accessible name that includes the count, and cap display at `99+`.
- **AC-NOTIF-3.4** The bell SHALL open a list of recent notifications, offer "Mark read" on unread ones (optimistic with rollback), and close on Escape.

#### REQ-NOTIF-4 · Events that create notifications

- **AC-NOTIF-4.1** WHEN a user registers, THEN they SHALL receive one unread `welcome` notification.
- **AC-NOTIF-4.2** WHEN a card is assigned to a user other than the actor, THEN that user SHALL receive `card_assigned`; self-assignment SHALL NOT notify.
- **AC-NOTIF-4.3** WHEN someone comments on a card, THEN the card's assignee and creator SHALL receive `comment_added`, excluding the commenter.
- **AC-NOTIF-4.4** WHEN an admin adds a user to a board, THEN that user SHALL receive `member_added`.

## 06 Analytics Dashboard

### Scope

Per-board analytics for administrators: cards per column, cards completed this week, and member activity, all computed with SQLAlchemy joins in the service layer.

### Requirements

#### REQ-ANL-1 · Cards per column

- **AC-ANL-1.1** WHEN a board admin calls `GET /api/boards/<id>/analytics`, THEN the API SHALL return `cards_per_column`: every live column in order with its live card count (zero for empty columns).
- **AC-ANL-1.2** Soft-deleted cards and columns SHALL NOT be counted.

#### REQ-ANL-2 · Cards completed this week

- **AC-ANL-2.1** The response SHALL include `completed_this_week`: the number of live cards in columns flagged `is_done` whose `column_entered_at` is on or after Monday 00:00 UTC of the current ISO week.
- **AC-ANL-2.2** WHEN a card entered a done column in an earlier week, THEN it SHALL NOT be counted.
- **AC-ANL-2.3** The response SHALL include `week_start` as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

#### REQ-ANL-3 · Member activity

- **AC-ANL-3.1** The response SHALL include `member_activity`: for every board member, `cards_assigned`, `cards_completed` (this week) and `comments_made`, counting only live content on this board.
- **AC-ANL-3.2** Members with no activity SHALL still appear with zeros.

#### REQ-ANL-4 · Access

- **AC-ANL-4.1** WHEN a non-admin member or a non-member calls, THEN `403`; WHEN no token, THEN `401`; WHEN the board does not exist, THEN `404`.

#### REQ-ANL-5 · Analytics dialog

- **AC-ANL-5.1** WHEN an admin opens "Analytics" on a board, THEN a `BaseModal` SHALL show completed-this-week, cards per column, and a member activity table.
- **AC-ANL-5.2** Members SHALL NOT see the Analytics action.
